title: Iggeret HaGra
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: 18th-century ethical will that the Vilna Gaon sent to his family before his planned immigration to Israel. Complete Musar text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Musar is Jewish ethical and devotional literature concerned with character, discipline and the conduct of ordinary life. Its genre ranges from short letters to systematic treatises.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
